sql: SELECT trip_date, trips, avg_total_amount, CASE WHEN dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_label FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 AND trip_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND trip_date < DATE '2025-02-01' ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 500
